{{Codex|Adorned with void hardened prisma crystal, this Gorgon variant is prized for its beauty and enhanced mechanics.}}

The '''Prisma Gorgon''' is the [[Prisma]] variant of the {{Weapon|Gorgon}}, featuring higher [[critical chance]], [[critical multiplier]], [[status chance]], fire rate, accuracy, magazine size and capacity, faster spool-up, and reload, at a slight expense of damage.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage.
*Requires a spool-up of '''7''' shots before optimal fire rate is achieved.
**Fire rate starts at '''20%''' of the listed value, and increases by '''13.33%''' per shot.
**Burst firing maintains spool-up.
*Can use the Gorgon-exclusive {{M|Metamorphic Magazine}} mod.
*Can use the Gorgon-exclusive mod {{M|Gorgon Frenzy}} ([[Conclave]] only).

{{Advantages|name=Prisma Gorgon|class=Rifle|trigger=Auto-Spool|}}

{{Disadvantages|name=Prisma Gorgon|class=Rifle|trigger=Auto-Spool|
* Spool-up creates a warm-up period of weakness for fire rate, making short engagements undesirable.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Gorgon}}
{{WeaponComparison|Gorgon Wraith|header=n}}

==Acquisition==
The Prisma Gorgon is potentially sold by [[Baro Ki'Teer]] in the Concourse section of the [[Tenno]] [[Relay]] for {{cc|50,000}} and {{dc|600}}. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

The weapon can be [[Trade System|traded]], but only for unranked copies without [[Forma]] and [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed. The trading recipient must also have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 11.

==Notes==
*While the Prisma Gorgon has the same vertical recoil behavior as the {{Weapon|Gorgon}} and the {{Weapon|Gorgon Wraith}}, it has significantly reduced horizontal recoil, which combined with higher accuracy stats makes the weapon overall more manageable at longer ranges.

==Incarnon Genesis==
*Upon completion of [[The Duviri Paradox]] and [[Angels of the Zariman]], and unlocking [[The Steel Path]], players can earn {{Resource|Gorgon Incarnon Genesis}} from [[The Circuit]]'s Steel Path to place on their Gorgon with the help of [[Cavalero]] in the [[Chrysalith]]. This [[Incarnon Genesis]] form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
**Alternatively, the Gorgon Incarnon Genesis can be bought from Cavalero for {{pc|120}}, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made '''once'''.

====Evolution====
{{Transclude|Gorgon Incarnon Genesis#Evolutions}}

==Tips==
*Like the {{Weapon|Gorgon}} and the {{Weapon|Gorgon Wraith}}, the Prisma Gorgon has a spool-down period in which it can retain its maximum rate of fire after releasing the trigger. Firing the weapon to maximum rate of fire, releasing the trigger and then firing before the spool-down period finishes allows the weapon to be fired in short bursts.
**Firing in bursts is essential for conserving ammo when used against groups of weaker enemies. Reserve using sustained full-auto fire at maximum spool for larger, tougher targets like [[Napalm]]s and [[Corpus Tech]]s.
*{{M|Speed Trigger}} and/or {{M|Shred}} speeds up the rate of fire, which subsequently reduces the time needed to spool up to maximum fire rate. Doing so will hasten the rate at which the weapon consumes ammo, however.
*The Prisma Gorgon's high rate of fire makes it ammo inefficient. {{M|Rifle Ammo Mutation}} and/or {{M|Rifle Scavenger}} mods can be used to maintain a steady supply of ammo. Alternatively, use [[Squad Ammo Restore]]s to instantly replenish ammo. Due to the weapon's large ammo reserve capacity, {{M|Ammo Drum}} will also have a higher and more beneficial impact. You can also make use of the [[Carrier]] Sentinel equipped with {{M|Ammo Case}}.
*Adding [[Punch Through]] via Shred or Metal Auger can aid ammo efficiency when dealing with large groups of enemies, particularly the [[Infested]].

==Trivia==
*The Prisma Gorgon was leaked as an entry in the player Profile under Equipment before it was formally introduced.
*Parts of the Prisma Gorgon have animated textures to differentiate it from its previous variants.
**The Prisma Gorgon also has modified firing sounds similar to a [[Prime]] weapon.
*The Prisma Gorgon's colors can be customized, a trait shared with its variants.
*The Prisma Gorgon was the first item to have the "''Prisma''" prefix in its name.
*Tied with {{Weapon|Soma}}/{{Weapon|Soma Prime}}, {{Weapon|Telos Boltor}}, and {{Weapon|Tenora Prime}} for the third highest [[critical chance]] of all fully automatic rifles, behind {{Weapon|Battacor}}, {{Weapon|Acceltra}} and {{Weapon|Acceltra Prime}}.

The '''Prisma Grakata''' is the [[Prisma]] variant of the {{Weapon|Grakata}} assault rifle, featuring enhanced fire rate, reload speed, critical damage, magazine, and ammo reserves.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage.
*Can use the Grakata-exclusive {{M|Brain Storm}} and {{M|Wild Frenzy}} mods.

{{Advantages|name=Prisma Grakata}}

{{Disadvantages|name=Prisma Grakata|
*High recoil.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Grakata}}

==Acquisition==
The Prisma Grakata is potentially sold by [[Baro Ki'Teer]] in the Concourse section of the [[Tenno]] [[Relay]] for {{cc|100,000}} and {{dc|610}}. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

The weapon can be [[Trade System|traded]], but only when unranked and without [[Forma]] or [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed. The trading recipient must also have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 11.

==Tips==
*Due to a high rate of fire and a high [[critical chance]], {{M|Critical Delay}} can be used with the Prisma Grakata to lower the fire rate (effectively making the weapon easier to handle and reduces ammo cost) and increase the [[critical chance]] at the cost of slightly lower overall DPS.
*Compared to other rifles with high rates of fire, the Prisma Grakata has a high chance to cause status effects, which goes well with builds designed to weaken, confuse, or stun enemies.

==Trivia==
*This weapon appeared in the [[Codex]] with {{ver|16.4}}, but was later removed from visibility in {{ver|16.4.3}}. It reappeared in the Codex in {{ver|16.7}}.
*Like other Prisma guns, the Prisma Grakata has a change to its firing sound when compared to the normal variant.
*The Prisma Grakata used to have the same reload animation as the {{Weapon|Ignis}} up until {{ver|18.5}}.
*Tied with {{Weapon|Buzlok}} for the second highest [[critical multiplier]] of all fully automatic rifles, behind {{Weapon|Tiberon Prime}}, {{Weapon|Soma}}/{{Weapon|Soma Prime}}, and {{Weapon|Baza}}/{{Weapon|Baza Prime}}.
*Third lowest base damage of all fully automatic rifles, after {{Weapon|Soma}}/{{Weapon|Soma Prime}}, and normal {{Weapon|Grakata}}.
*Highest [[fire rate]] of all primary weapons.

{{Top|Enemy|Corpus|Corpus|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Imbued with the finest Prisma crystal, this refined Angstrum features boosted charge and reload speeds.}} The '''Prisma Angstrum''' is the [[Prisma]] variant of the [[Corpus]]-built rocket pistol {{Weapon|Angstrum}}, featuring slightly higher [[critical chance]], [[critical multiplier]], and faster charge-up and [[reload speed]]. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Blast}} damage. *Rocket explode in a '''3.6''' meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Can benefit from {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}). *Can be charged to unload more of the weapon's magazine and fire extra projectiles. **Can be fired with a partial charge to fire only part of its magazine. **Charged barrage spreads rockets out, reducing the effective range considerably. **[[Multishot]] will cause partially-charged shots to spread out further, eliminating its long range potential. **Fully charged shot consumes the entire magazine, even when magazine mods are used. *Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity. {{Advantages| *Tied with normal {{Weapon|Angstrum}} for highest base damage of all secondaries. *High [[accuracy]]. *Very fast charge speed. }} {{Disadvantages| *Projectiles have travel time, slow speed, and are small, making long range shots difficult. *Very high recoil. *The weapon fires as soon as it has reached a full charge, which can lead to premature firing. *Extremely low magazine size of 3 rounds; requires frequent reloading. *Rockets have a short delay after firing before being able to fire again. *Enemies can destroy the rockets with gunfire or area of effect explosions. *Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. *Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 60% from central impact. }} {{WeaponComparison|Angstrum}} ==Acquisition== The Prisma Angstrum can be sold by [[Baro Ki'Teer]] in the Concourse section of the [[Tenno]] [[Relay]] for {{cc|210,000}} and {{dc|475}}. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance. The weapon can be [[Trade System|traded]], but only for unranked copies without [[Forma]] and [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed. The trading recipient must also have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 8. ==Notes== *Rockets launched by the Prisma Angstrum have an initial speed of '''0.5''' m/s, then accelerate at '''15''' m/s2 until they reach their maximum speed of '''150''' m/s. **When firing more than one rocket, they will curve outwards in a flower shape. **[[Projectile Speed]] does not affect the spread of the rockets or make them more accurate, but it does change their trajectory on the way to their destination. ***High [[Projectile Speed]] makes them fly in a straight line towards their destination, spreading out immediately like a shotgun. ***Low [[Projectile Speed]] makes them stick together in a line for a few meters before blossoming outwards in a curved trajectory. **Although single rockets are very accurate, firing multiple rockets is drastically affected by [[Accuracy]] penalties such as from [[Magnum Force]]. *Tapping the trigger will auto charge and fire a single rocket; holding the trigger will charge a shot that adds an additional rocket for every '''0.2''' seconds the trigger is held. Added shots are limited by the current magazine capacity. **Added rockets will consume an equivalent amount of magazine. **Charged shots cannot be held; the Prisma Angstrum will fire as soon as it is fully charged. **Use the reload button or changing weapons will cancel charged shots. *There is a soft cap of '''16 rockets''' due to the firing pattern. The first three inner rockets are arranged in a triangle, the next five rockets are in the shape of a pentagon, and the last eight outer rockets will be in the shape of an octagon. After the 16th rocket, any further rockets will not cover any more area and will stack in one place, usually on the topmost or rightmost rocket. == Incarnon Genesis == {{Transclude|Angstrum Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}} {{Transclude|Angstrum Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}} ==Trivia== *The Prisma Angstrum is the first [[Prisma]] secondary ever released. ==Media== PAngstrum.png|Prisma Angstrum in the Codex. {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|TfaBxFlNOUI|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|4eFusJAv7eg|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|JtIRPMyuPYM|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 3 Ammo per Pick Up: *Prisma Angstrum ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. {{ver|27.2.2}}
Reduced the following AoE weapons Radial Damage Falloff from central impact that were all previously 90%: *Prisma Angstrum: 40% {{ver|27.2}} ;Self Damage Changes: We are getting rid of Self Damage and replacing it with something else: instead of Self Damage, it’s now ‘Stagger’. This change completely removes the chance of killing yourself, and instead now creates scenarios where you will interrupt yourself - or ‘Stagger’ - to varying degrees if you aren’t careful. The degrees of Self-Interrupt start with a small stumble all the way to full knockdown depending on how close you are to the center of explosion. Any Mods referring to Self Damage will be converted to acknowledge Stagger. With this Self-Interrupt system, we have added dozens of new recovery animations that harness a ninja-like recovery experience. By pressing ‘Jump’ at the correct time, you can execute a ninja-skill-based knockdown recovery to ALL in-game knockdowns. This ninja recovery window is indicated by a glowing FX on your Warframe. In the original Dev Workshop, we said:
''As a result of this overall systemic change, Weapons with Stagger will be getting approximately a 20% buff in Damage, with any weapons with AOE receiving a 50% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact.'' This is no longer accurate after continued testing. What we are doing now is: No damage buffs have been added, but any weapons with AOE are receiving ~20% increase in Radius. Additionally, AOE weapons are receiving a 90% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact. This means on the very outer section of the explosion Radius 10% of the Damage will be dealt. Tactics will be deadly - aim true, Tenno. ''Why: Several players brought up the history of the Tonkor and we want to make sure we ship this change in a place that’s conservative in its starting point from a balance perspective. The complete removal of Self Damage does change the pace of destruction with some of the game’s most powerful weapons, so we want to make sure we can iterate upwardly instead of releasing a bonanza of explosions with no other choices.'' ;Greater than 100% Status having meaning: Shotguns have a unique Role here based on a very patch-work history with how they interact with Status Chance. A Shotgun that shoots 99% Status Chance would give you 35% (roughly) status per pellet. 100% Status Gives you 100% Status per pellet. This huge jump in performance happens with just a 1% gain - why? Well, to answer that we have to look at our choice to make what the UI conveys reality. It would feel broken to shoot a Shotgun with 100% Status and not see a perfect spread of Effects. In reality, to make Status consistent we have to treat Shotguns as a special case. Shotguns as a special case means we have buffed the Status Chance of all Shotguns by x3 or greater. The UI now behaves to show the reality that you are determining Status Chance per pellet. {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 4 to 8. *Direct Impact damage increased from 175 to 200. *Status chance increased from 10 to 26%. *Critical chance increased from 10% to 18%. *Critical damage increased from 2x to 2.2x. *Ammo capacity decreased from 30 to 18. {{ver|22.0}} *Improved the mesh quality of the Prisma Angstrum to avoid blocky textures. *Fixed Clients not seeing the Host's Prisma Angstrum ammo magazine cycle correctly. {{ver|21.7.1}} *The Prisma Angstrum is now tradable! *Tweaked the firing sounds of the Prisma Angstrum. {{ver|21.7}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|23.10.8}} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Angstrum}}, the original version of this weapon *[[Baro Ki'Teer]] {{VoidTraderNav}} {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Prisma Angstrum]] [[es:Angstrum Prisma]] [[Category:Baro Ki'Teer Offering]] [[Category:Special Weapons]] [[uk:Анґструм-призма]]
